raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Persistent "monokernels" run most of a decoder layer, including its TP all-reduce, in one or two launches, which removes the launch gaps and collective latency that dominate small-batch decode. RFC #43949 proposes one framework for them. This PR is that framework, with the kernels themselves living outside SGLang in vendor plugins: AMD's are in [sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono) (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and its DSpark draft on MI350X / MI355X).

## Modifications

- Add `--monokernel-backend <name>` in `exec.kernel`, an experimental feature, disabled by default; selecting a backend logs that its kernels, coverage and plugin API may change. General plugins (`sglang.srt.plugins`) register a backend's spec per architecture through `sglang.srt.monokernels.spec.register`; specs load lazily and declare the API version they target (`MONOKERNEL_API_VERSION`, bumped on any breaking change, like `SERVE_BACKEND_API_VERSION` for `sglang serve` backends).
- Validate the selected target spec in the configuration pipeline (`guards.handle_monokernel`) and align configured decode capture sizes with its supported widths. A spec states what it needs as data (`Requirements`: dtype, decode-phase attention backend, server arguments, HF config fields, SGLang environment variables), checked the same way for every spec; an optional `config_disable_reasons` covers the rest. Observe checkpoint tensors before model-specific conversion (`runtime.monokernel_weights_iterator`) so plugins can retain required weight copies, and refuse a spec that keeps copies when the load path skipped the observer.
- Build the selected spec after weight loading, before KV sizing (`runtime.install_monokernel_forward`), and install a full-forward dispatcher that preserves the model's signature. Every built width of the model's step (decode, or verify on a speculative server at any token count) uses the plugin's forward; other shapes use the original forward. Models with derived weight copies refuse online weight updates.
- Decide alike on every TP rank: the ranks exchange spec lookups (outcome, registration, reason, spec name and API version) before branching, so an unregistered draft keeps its forward everywhere, and a broken or mismatched spec on any rank fails startup on every rank. Supported graph keys are fixed at install and compared across ranks; routing reads only a step's graph key. Before the plugin's first forward, with or without CUDA graphs, the switch checks the decode attention backend that step runs on, since a draft runner may override the one the launcher checked.
- Check coverage against the graphs the runner actually captured (alignment and request-pool limits can drop configured sizes): a capture hook fails startup when no captured graph runs the plugin, and logs the captured and eager steps that run the monokernels.
- Type the plugin API (`BuiltMonokernels` with `forward`, the spec callbacks' signatures, `Plan`) and state the forward's obligations: the model forward's arguments and outputs, the KV cache and auxiliary hidden-state writes of the standard path for every row, padded rows included, and CUDA-graph capturability. Keep framework code in `python/sglang/srt/monokernels/`; vendor kernels and model-specific forwards remain in their plugin packages.
- Pin sgl-amd-mono in the `srt_hip` extras of `pyproject_other.toml`, so AMD installs (and SGLang's ROCm images) include the plugin; `--monokernel-backend amd` stays opt-in. Add the server-argument documentation row.
- Register CPU tests for spec lookup, validation (every requirement kind, including decode-backend overrides), graph-size alignment, forward routing/signatures, step modes (a one-token draft block is a verify step), the per-step backend check, per-step state, rank-uniform lookup and spec identity, captured and eager coverage, weight observation and a load path that skips it, deadlines, the runtime's reads of a published config, and the SGLang names the framework reads off GPU-only objects. Vendor kernel and serving tests live in the plugin repository.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MI350X, TP4, 04fcb04e34 with sgl-amd-mono 8f1bff3 (on the DSpark server, target and draft both on monokernels). Each server steps past the largest covered width and back as its batch fills and drains:

| | DSpark (verify steps) | Decode (no speculation) | Bound | Normal path |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GSM8K, 200 questions, 8-shot | 0.920 | 0.875 | > 0.85 | 0.88 to 0.91 |
| Mean KL of the covered steps' tokens vs the normal prefill path (8 LongBench-v2 prompts) | 0.0118 | 0.0119 | < 0.03 | about 0.007 |

A fault injected on one rank stops every rank, and no token of the failed step reaches the client. CPU tests: `test/registered/unit/monokernels` 17 passed; the plugin's serving tests (above) 9 passed. Not executed: MI355X, and AgentX at TP2 (in progress).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Per-user decode tok/s, real DSpark acceptance (mean accept length 3.72 off, 3.69 on), monokernels off -> on: 1 request 444.1 -> 776.0 (+75%), 4 requests 362.8 -> 441.4 (+22%), 8 requests 267.4 -> 327.5 (+22%). Measured at 05e333df70 with sgl-amd-mono 905f61b; the later commits change startup checks and logging, not the step path.

AgentX (the published MI355X agentic recipe, run on MI350X, TP4, DSpark, 1 concurrent user for 900 s, forced acceptance 3.51): P90 410.3 -> 543.8 tok/s/user (+32.5%), P50 438.6 -> 591.5 (+34.9%), 117 -> 132 requests. Both arms ran with the simulated-acceptance fold, a separate PR that keeps sampled verify steps on the CUDA graph under forced acceptance. Measured with sgl-amd-mono 8faf602, before its K2i indexer kernel; not rerun since.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

+"""Experimental full-forward dispatch for vendor monokernel plugins.
+
+General plugins register specs through the sglang.srt.plugins entry point.
+The runtime validates configuration, observes weight loading, and routes
+supported steps through the selected spec; other steps use the model forward.
+"""

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Startup validation, graph-size alignment, and wait deadlines for monokernels."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import (
+    attention_backends_of,
+    declare_resolution,
+    model_config_of,
+    resolving_view,
+)
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import Phase, with_phase
+from sglang.srt.monokernels.spec import Feature, MonoSpec, NumericsKind, find_spec
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import ModelConfig
+    from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Leave time for peers to abort before the process watchdog fires.
+MAX_DEADLINE_S, MIN_DEADLINE_S = 60.0, 5.0
+
+
+def deadline_s(watchdog_timeout: Optional[float]) -> float:
+    """Return half the watchdog timeout, capped at MAX_DEADLINE_S."""
+    if not watchdog_timeout or watchdog_timeout <= 0:
+        return MAX_DEADLINE_S
+    return min(MAX_DEADLINE_S, 0.5 * float(watchdog_timeout))
+
+
+def device_isa() -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the GPU ISA without feature suffixes, or None without a GPU."""
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return None
+    props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.cuda.current_device())
+    if torch.version.hip:
+        return props.gcnArchName.split(":")[0]
+    return f"sm_{props.major}{props.minor}"
+
+
+def _ragged_verify(cfg: Any) -> bool:
+    mode = envs.SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE.get().lower()
+    return cfg.speculative_algorithm is not None and mode != "static"
+
+
+# PARTITIONED_GPU needs the device, so install checks it
+_PROBES = {
+    Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL: lambda c: c.pp_size > 1,
+    Feature.MULTI_NODE_TP: lambda c: c.nnodes > 1,
+    Feature.DP_ATTENTION: lambda c: (
+        bool(c.enable_dp_attention) or (c.attn_dp_size or 1) > 1
+    ),
+    Feature.EXPERT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (c.ep_size or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.EPLB: lambda c: bool(c.enable_eplb),
+    Feature.CONTEXT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (
+        (c.attn_cp_size or 1) > 1 or (c.dcp_size or 1) > 1 or bool(c.enable_prefill_cp)
+    ),
+    Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING: lambda c: c.speculative_algorithm is not None,
+    Feature.RAGGED_VERIFY: _ragged_verify,
+    Feature.TWO_BATCH_OVERLAP: lambda c: bool(
+        c.enable_two_batch_overlap or c.enable_single_batch_overlap
+    ),
+    Feature.LORA: lambda c: bool(c.enable_lora or c.lora_paths),
+    Feature.PD_DISAGGREGATION: lambda c: (c.disaggregation_mode or "null") != "null",
+    Feature.RETURN_ROUTED_EXPERTS: lambda c: bool(c.enable_return_routed_experts),
+    Feature.RETURN_INDEXER_TOPK: lambda c: bool(c.enable_return_indexer_topk),
+    Feature.EAGLE3_HIDDEN_STATES: lambda c: (
+        (c.speculative_algorithm or "").upper() == "EAGLE3"
+    ),
+    Feature.KV_OFFLOAD: lambda c: bool(
+        c.enable_hierarchical_cache
+        or c.disaggregation_decode_enable_offload_kvcache
+        or c.enable_lmcache
+        or c.enable_flexkv
+    ),
+    Feature.MEMORY_RELEASE: lambda c: bool(
+        c.enable_memory_saver or c.enable_weights_cpu_backup
+    ),
+    Feature.CPU_OFFLOAD: lambda c: (
+        (c.cpu_offload_gb or 0) > 0 or (c.offload_group_size or 0) > 0
+    ),
+    Feature.TORCH_COMPILE: lambda c: bool(c.enable_torch_compile),
+}
+
+
+def features_in_use(cfg: Any) -> set[Feature]:
+    return {feature for feature, probe in _PROBES.items() if probe(cfg)}
+
+
+def monokernel_disable_reasons(
+    *, cfg: Any, model_config: ModelConfig, isa: Optional[str]
+) -> tuple[Optional[MonoSpec], list[str]]:
+    """Return the matching spec and all configuration rejection reasons."""
+    if isa is None:
+        return None, ["no GPU is visible"]
+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    spec, why = find_spec(
+        backend=cfg.monokernel_backend, architectures=hf_config.architectures, isa=isa
+    )
+    if spec is None:
+        return None, [why]
+    reasons = [
+        f"{f.value} is in use and the spec does not accept it"
+        for f in sorted(features_in_use(cfg) - spec.features, key=lambda f: f.name)
+    ]
+    req = spec.requires
+    dtype = str(model_config.dtype).replace("torch.", "")  # resolved, e.g. bfloat16
+    _, decode_backend = attention_backends_of(cfg)
+    one_of = [
+        ("tp_size", cfg.tp_size, spec.devices[isa].tp_sizes),
+        ("dtype", dtype, req.dtypes),
+        # Served steps run on the decode-phase backend.
+        ("decode attention backend", decode_backend, req.attention_backends),
+    ] + [(arg, getattr(cfg, arg), ok) for arg, ok in req.server_args.items()]
+    exactly = [
+        # another model's config may not have the field at all
+        (f"config.{key}", getattr(hf_config, key, None), want)
+        for key, want in req.hf_config.items()

+            names.add(node.name)
+        elif isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign)):
+            targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]
+            for target in targets:

+                    elif isinstance(t, ast.Attribute):

+        with capturing:
+            for bs in (2, 4):  # the check waits for every captured size
+                check(runner(capture_bs=[2, 4]), None, batch("decode", bs, bs), bs)
+        self.assertTrue(check.is_done)
+        # a step pads up to a captured graph that holds it: only a served key past
+        # the largest graph of its mode runs eagerly
+        eager = runtime._eager_keys(served=served, captured=check.captured.values())
+        self.assertEqual([k.batch_size for k in eager], [8])
+
+    def test_the_runtime_reads_the_published_config(self):
+        graphs = with_phase(default_cuda_graph_config(), Phase.DECODE, bs=[1, 2, 8])
+        publish(
+            ServerArgs(
+                model_path="dummy",
+                monokernel_backend=BACKEND,
+                speculative_algorithm="DSPARK",
+                speculative_num_draft_tokens=6,
+                cuda_graph_config=graphs,
+            ),
+            role="test",
+        )
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        self.assertEqual(runtime._backend(), BACKEND)
+        mode, tokens = runtime._server_step()
+        self.assertEqual((mode, tokens), ("target_verify", 6))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [
+                (k.forward_mode, k.batch_size, k.rows)
+                for k in runtime._capture_keys(mode=mode, tokens=tokens)
+            ],
+            [
+                ("target_verify", 1, 6),
+                ("target_verify", 2, 12),
+                ("target_verify", 8, 48),
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_deadlines_stay_below_the_watchdog(self):
+        self.assertEqual(deadline_s(None), MAX_DEADLINE_S)
+        self.assertEqual(deadline_s(3600), MAX_DEADLINE_S)
+        self.assertEqual(deadline_s(30), 15.0)
+
